clue.text: People offering professional models

parts.note: pro is the short form of professional
models who sit for artists are posers

explanation.surface: Fashion people put forward some professional models.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who put forward a motion or a marriage offer are its proposers.

clue.text: Tripe so prepared is making a comeback

indicators.note: prepared suggests the letters are made up into a new form, as food is

explanation.surface: Tripe cooked this way is returning to fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick, sharp reply, a retort.

clue.text: He's made a promise to take a part in the exercises

indicators.note: in places the article and the word for part inside the word for exercises

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercises
a role is a part in a play

explanation.surface: A man who has pledged to play a role in the training session.
explanation.walkthrough: A parolee is released on his promise of good behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: A prisoner freed early on his word to keep good conduct.

clue.text: Nathan in step? Rot!

indicators.note: in means the short name goes inside the word for step

parts.note: a stage is a step in a process
Nat is a short form of Nathan

explanation.surface: Is Nathan keeping in step? Nonsense!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rot!' looks like an exclamation of disbelief, but is the verb to decay.
explanation.definitionFit: To become stale and decay, as still water does.

clue.text: Shade needed for projected entertainment

explanation.surface: A shade is needed for a film show.
explanation.definitionFit: A screen can be a shelter that shades; the screen also stands for cinema itself.

clue.text: The company not in favour of proceeding

parts.note: con, as in pros and cons, is an argument against
a course is a way of proceeding

explanation.surface: The firm does not like the way things are going.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering or throng of people, a crowd assembled together.

clue.text: Bird sanctuary organised by a woman on certain lines

parts.note: her is the pronoun for a woman
RY is short for railway, lines of track

explanation.surface: A wildlife reserve run by a woman along particular lines.
explanation.definitionFit: A breeding colony where grey wading birds nest together.

clue.text: Being peevish about cash advance for show

indicators.note: about means the word for peevish goes around the other pieces

parts.note: sour means bad-tempered or peevish
p, a penny, is a piece of cash
to lend is to advance money

explanation.surface: Someone is grumpy about a loan put on for display.
explanation.definitionFit: Magnificence or grand display, pomp and show.

clue.text: A near thing for the cameraman!

definitions.text: A near thing for the cameraman!

parts.words: A near thing for the cameraman!
parts.note: a narrow escape in the surface, but read literally a shot taken from very near the subject by the photographer

explanation.surface: A cameraman has a narrow escape.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight shot of a face or object, filmed from very little distance, is this kind of picture.

clue.text: Tough guy hits back with lash

indicators.note: back tells us the word for hits is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: raps are sharp knocks or hits
to tan someone's hide is to thrash or lash them

explanation.surface: A hard man strikes back with a whip.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone austere and hardy, like a citizen of ancient Sparta, is described by this word.

clue.text: Put inside a letter and then seal

parts.note: en is the spelt-out name of the letter N
to seal something is to close it

explanation.surface: Someone slips something into an envelope and seals it.
explanation.definitionFit: To place something within a cover or envelope is to put it inside.

clue.text: Set off, and please walk

indicators.note: to set something off can mean to rearrange it, so the following letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone invites a companion to start out on a stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: A promenade along a seafront, a level public walk.

clue.text: Derides reforms when asked

indicators.note: reforms suggests the word is made into a new shape

explanation.surface: A critic changes their tune when asked.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanted or requested, an old sense of asked for.

clue.text: In consequence some paper investigated

indicators.note: In means the word for paper goes inside the word for consequence

parts.note: an end is a result or consequence
a quire is a quantity of paper, 24 or 25 sheets

explanation.surface: As a result, a newspaper looked into the matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Asked questions about or looked into, a synonym of investigated.

clue.text: Return to original own, ers about the green

parts.note: re is a short word for about or concerning
vert is the heraldic word for green

explanation.surface: Property goes back to its former holders over the village green.
explanation.definitionFit: Property is said to go back in law to the people who held it before.

clue.text: Person answering a note with a point to consider

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
S, south, is a compass point
to ponder is to consider

explanation.surface: Someone replying with a memo containing a thought to mull over.
explanation.definitionFit: One who replies or reacts to a call, such as an emergency worker.

clue.text: Helping a French article make good sense

parts.note: a ration is a portion or helping
le is the French definite article

explanation.surface: A portion with a French article makes sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The reasoning or logic behind something, the sound grounds for it.

clue.text: They stick up for those wanting to get a look, in

definitions.text: They stick up for those wanting to get a look, in

parts.words: They stick up for those wanting to get a look, in
parts.note: seems to describe defenders of the excluded, but describes rooftop rods that serve television viewers wanting to see a programme

explanation.surface: Supporters stand up for those who want a chance to join in.
explanation.walkthrough: A look-in is a chance to take part; here it is a chance to look in on the television.
explanation.definitionFit: Rods on roofs that receive broadcast signals stand up for television viewers.

clue.text: Possibly left with sale brochures

indicators.note: possibly signals that these letters may be put another way

explanation.surface: Flyers perhaps left out together with sale catalogues.
explanation.definitionFit: Printed sheets handed out to advertise, a kind of pamphlet.

clue.text: Writing about a motorway contract

indicators.note: about means the word for writing wraps around the motorway

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language
the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI

explanation.surface: A piece of writing about a motorway deal.
explanation.definitionFit: An undertaking or pledge, something binding like an agreement.

clue.text: Stranger always, and that is right

parts.note: e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, meaning always
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: An outsider is always right, it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: More spooky or uncanny, the comparative of weird in that sense.

clue.text: Bread crock upended as a sort of desk

parts.note: a roll is a small loaf of bread

indicators.note: upended in a down clue means the word for crock is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: a crock is an earthenware pot

explanation.surface: A bread bin turned upside down serves as a desk.
explanation.definitionFit: A writing bureau with a flexible slatted cover that slides up.

clue.text: Oriental rat causing much damage

parts.note: E, east, stands for oriental
a rat is a type of rodent

explanation.surface: An Eastern rat wreaking havoc.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing away or corrosive, describing something that eats into tissue.

clue.text: Left before about one curtain in doorway

indicators.note: about means the first pieces wrap around the numeral for one

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
ere is an old word for before
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone left ahead of one o'clock, drawing a drape across the door.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy hanging drape hung across an entrance in place of, or beside, a door.

clue.text: Man reading Arnold novel

indicators.note: novel as an adjective means new, so the name is made new by rearrangement

explanation.surface: A man reading a book by Arnold.
explanation.definitionFit: A male given name, as of the hero of the Chanson de Roland.

clue.text: Fraternal member, yet not even a peer

parts.note: an odd number is one that is not even
a fellow is an equal or peer

explanation.surface: A member of a brotherhood is nevertheless no equal of a lord.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oddfellows are a British friendly society, a mutual fraternal organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a friendly society, a fraternal order offering mutual support.

clue.text: So called lion-man running wild

indicators.note: running wild suggests the letters are let loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: A man-lion creature called by that name is on the loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Existing in name only, as something merely so termed.

clue.text: Try to accept the growth of moorland

indicators.note: to accept means the word for try takes in the next word

parts.note: a judge hears or tries a case

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to welcome the plants growing on the moor.
explanation.definitionFit: A low purple-flowered shrub, ling, which covers upland moors.

clue.text: Record is turning, left on by a Greek character

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record

indicators.note: turning means the little word is spun round to read backwards

explanation.surface: A record is spinning on the left, beside a Greek character.
explanation.definitionFit: The fifth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Lavish with one's drink in time

indicators.note: in means the pieces for one's and drink go inside the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time
I's, one's, with I as the pronoun or numeral one
a sip is a small drink

explanation.surface: Someone is generous with their drink, in time.
explanation.definitionFit: To squander or spend wastefully, the verb sense of lavish.
